title: Preserve to Expand: Source-Aware Adaptation and Model Merging for Multilingual LLM-Based ASR
abstract: arXiv:2610.35846v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Expanding multilingual ASR systems to new languages is challenging when adaptation must preserve previously supported languages without replaying source-language training data. We study this problem in connector-based Speech LLMs, where a trainable connector maps speech representations into a frozen large language model. We evaluate target-update construction and merging strategies for adapting the connector while preserving source-language performance. In single-target expansion, target-only fine-tuning and standard TIES merging learn new languages but cause severe source-language forgetting, while SSU-Wanda+TIES gives the best source-preserving trade-off. In multi-target expansion, update merging provides stable source retention, whereas recursive expansion can improve target adaptation under favorable orders but is highly order-sensitive. These results show that multilingual ASR expansion requires balancing target acquisition, source

translated_title: 保先以扩：面向多语言大语言模型语音识别的源语言感知适配与模型合并
translated_abstract: 在必须保留先前已支持语言且无法重放源语言训练数据的情况下，将多语言语音识别（ASR）系统扩展到新语言极具挑战性。我们在基于连接器（connector）的语音大语言模型中研究这一问题，其中可训练的连接器将语音表征映射到冻结的大语言模型中。我们评估了在适配连接器的同时保持源语言性能的目标更新构建与合并策略。在单目标扩展中，仅针对目标语言的微调和标准TIES合并能够学习新语言，但会导致严重的源语言遗忘，而SSU-Wanda+TIES在源语言保持方面提供了最佳权衡。在多目标扩展中，更新合并提供了稳定的源语言保持能力，而递归扩展在合适的顺序下可以改善目标语言适配效果，但对顺序高度敏感。这些结果表明，多语言ASR扩展需要在目标语言习得与源语言（保持）之间取得平衡。
tldr: 该论文提出了在基于连接器的语音大语言模型中扩展多语言ASR时的适配与合并策略评估，发现SSU-Wanda+TIES合并策略在单目标扩展中实现了最佳的目标语言习得与源语言保持权衡，而更新合并在多目标扩展中提供了稳定的源语言保持能力。
en_tdlr: This paper evaluates adaptation and merging strategies for expanding multilingual ASR in connector-based Speech LLMs, showing that SSU-Wanda+TIES merging achieves the best target acquisition and source-preserving trade-off in single-target expansion, while update merging provides stable source retention in multi-target expansion.
